title: Eric Walker claimed Majestic 12 membership; Azadehdel conversation

tellings.quote: seemed to claim that he was part of the

plain: Eric A. Walker, a man connected to Penn State university, is said to have hinted that he belonged to Majestic 12, a secret US government group that some say was formed to handle crashed UFOs. According to Michels, Walker "seemed to claim" this in a conversation with a man named Henry Azadehdel. Michels brings it up in an episode with the UFO researcher Grant Cameron, whose work he draws on, and he leaves the details vague.
